title: meet the carton: need 1 more to make a dozen... what should it be?
author: rectangle_so
selftext:
these are the 11 playable characters in my browser game EggVerse. i originally sketched these out and collaborated with a pixel artists to make some of them years ago for a game i ended up shutting down, and now they finally have a home again!

we're one short of a dozen and i can't decide what the 12th should be.

drop your idea below. if i make yours, i'll credit you in the game 🫣

comments.author: rectangle_so
comments.body: if you want to try them out, EggVerse is free to play in your browser [eggverse.co](https://eggverse.co)

comments.author: rectangle_so
comments.body:
Here are my current ideas:   
  
Over Easy, a chill surfer egg  
Deviled Egg, a little devil with horns  
Benny, a fancy egg in a top hat   
Poached, a sneaky thief egg  
Omelette, a sad Shakespeare-style egg

comments.body: The fractured: an egg like the first plain egg but shattered and held together by bandaids
